asks.questionText: Composing melody and bass notes from a set of chords at cadence points Preparatory work: • Write out the scale of B flat major on the stave below: • Plot the chords available in this key (I, ii, IV, V and vi) either in the chord bank grid or on the stave below. The first chord is given. • Study the piece of music on the following page. • Using the given rhythms, add melody and bass notes to complete the cadences and approach chords as follows: (i) At A, a PLAGAL cadence with approach chord (I–IV–I) (ii) At B, an IMPERFECT cadence with approach chord (vi–ii–V) (iii) At C, an INTERRUPTED cadence with approach chord (I–V–vi) (iv) At D, a PERFECT cadence with approach chord (IV–V–I)

grid.stem: Answer one question only in this section:
taskRequirements: Same chord in adjacent boxes not accepted
Accidental and suffix, where relevant, must be fully correct for mark to be awarded
Chords must be part of a good progression

Stepwise movement to and from inversions = good

criteria.label: Up to 2.5 marks per chord
1 mark per correct melody note which is part of the chord and which falls on the correct beat of the bar

Up to 2 marks for quality of the correct bass line at each cadence point

asks.notes: Section B: the "Preparatory work" (scale and chord bank) is MARKED at Ordinary Level ("Grid / Stave", "Up to 2.5 marks per chord", 2.5 X 4 = 10), so its bullets are part of the question text and its line is a counted criterion at the printed 2.5 x 4 (lane ruling: marked preparatory work is counted), as 2022 Ordinary. JUDGEMENT CALL (as 2022): the scheme says "Up to" 2.5 a chord, so a part-correct chord may earn less than 2.5, which a counted line on 0/2.5/5/7.5/10 cannot place. The chord bank prints I ("The first chord is given") and iii and vii° filled in and shaded, so the four chords asked for are ii, IV, V and vi. Each "1 mark per ... (1 X 12)" line is counted, each "Up to 2 marks for quality ... (2 X 4)" line a no-band criterion on 0-8 (the 2021 COVID-adjusted tariff: 10 + 20 + 20 = 50). The Section B general points (scheme p6, unnumbered bullets in 2021) are carried on all three questions. The 2021 Ordinary scheme prints NO table of given or accepted chords, so there is no scheme crop. The "1 X 12" / "2 X 4" sit in the scheme's Mark column, so the labels carry the descriptor only. "Preparatory work:" is a printed heading, not an ask. Q4's (i)-(iv) name the cadences at A-D; one ask, one total. Key B flat major, 4/4.
